summary: @servicetitan/ld-type-generator preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute a 727KB obfuscated payload unrelated to its advertised CLI
details: The package declares `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"` in package.json. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync with `math_init.js` as the argument. math_init.js is a ~727KB `@bun @bun-cjs` bundle with string-array rotation obfuscation (WV8StW shift routine over a multi-thousand-entry constant table) and hex-named identifiers, with no readable strings. The advertised functionality (main: dist/cli.js) is a ~4KB axios+meow CLI that calls app.launchdarkly.com to generate LaunchDarkly TypeScript types; neither dist/cli.js nor the README references setup.mjs, the Bun runtime, or math_init.js. The install-time chain therefore fetches a second runtime specifically to execute an opaque, obfuscated blob wholly unrelated to the package's stated purpose. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: on every `npm install`, an alien runtime is used to run code that Node-focused scanners cannot inspect, with no build or feature justification.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
